description: Close a pick link you made with show_shop_to_owner before it expires, for example when your human already told you what they want or you shared it by mistake. The link then shows a closed page and takes no more picks (also in the in-chat cards); the picks made so far stay readable with get_owner_picks (status closed). Closing again changes nothing. Only the passport that made it.

passport_token.description: Your amp_ token, only if your client cannot send it as an Authorization header; leave it out when your MCP app signed in.

name: close_shop_window
title: Close a pick link
